ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious ASP.NET Compilation Via AspNetCompiler
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "aspnet_compiler.exe" with potentially suspicious paths for compilation.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework64\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\FrameworkArm\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\FrameworkArm64\\\\.*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\aspnet\\_compiler\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*")))
